response.text:
I'll propose a correction that moves the 8406.47 debit from retired account 5900 to active account 5300 (Facilities), per the journal memo, in open period 11 or 12. The period should match the original journal's intent; the original journal is in PRD_ID 9 (closed), so I'll post the correction to an open period. Since the finding covers only journal 1941, I'll reverse the 5900 line and re-debit 5300.

Note the correction must net to the right amounts: original has DR 5900 8406.47 / CR 2000 8406.47. The correction should DR 5300 8406.47 and CR 5900 8406.47, leaving 5300 debited and 5900 net zero.

arguments.reasoning: Journal 1941 (invoice V0020-18438-572, memo "charge to 5300 Facilities") debited retired account 5900 for 8406.47 instead of active account 5300. Correction reclassifies the expense: debit 5300 Facilities 8406.47 and credit 5900 8406.47, so 5900 nets to zero for this invoice and 5300 carries the charge. Posted to open period 11 since journal 1941's period 9 is closed. The offsetting 2000 Accounts Payable line is correct and is left unchanged. No invoice status change: this is not a duplicate. Journal 2271 is out of scope for this finding.
